## Change type

## Public-safety checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, API keys, private keys, or `.env` values are included.
- [ ] No database URLs, private endpoint names, or local machine paths are included.
- [ ] No production schemas, source adapters, scoring internals, model code, or live data are included.
- [ ] No member-only, monetization, or unreleased private workflow details are included.
- [ ] Any screenshot or visual asset has been manually reviewed before publication.
- [ ] Language remains descriptive and public-safe, with no buy/sell guidance, price targets, guarantees, or personalized financial advice.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `python scripts/check_public_repo_contract.py`.
- [ ] Markdown links and image references are valid.
- [ ] Sample-data fields are documented if sample data changed.
- [ ] README or supporting docs were updated if repo structure changed.
